en: For forty days after his suffering, Jesus appears to the apostles and speaks about the kingdom of God.
He tells them to wait in Jerusalem, for they will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.
He says they will receive power and be his witnesses in Jerusalem, Judea, Samaria and to the ends of the earth.
He is lifted up as they watch, and a cloud takes him out of their sight.
Two men in white say this Jesus will come back in the same way.
The apostles, with the women, Mary the mother of Jesus and his brothers, devote themselves to prayer.
They cast lots, and Matthias takes the place of Judas among the apostles.
zh: 耶穌受害以後四十天之久，向使徒顯現，講論神國的事。
他吩咐他們留在耶路撒冷等候，因為他們要受聖靈的洗。
他說他們要得着能力，在耶路撒冷、猶太、撒馬利亞，直到地極作他的見證人。
他們正看的時候，他被接上升，有一朵雲彩把他接去。
兩個穿白衣的人說，這位耶穌怎樣升天，還要怎樣回來。
使徒和婦女們、耶穌的母親馬利亞以及他的弟弟們，一同同心禱告。
他們抽籤，馬提亞就補上猶大的位置，與使徒同列。

about.en: Luke's first account of the ascension
about.zh: 路加在福音書中記載的升天

about.en: Sit at my right hand
about.zh: 你坐在我的右邊

about.en: One like a son of man comes with the clouds
about.zh: 有一位像人子的，駕着天雲而來

about.en: The Lord will come down from heaven
about.zh: 主要從天降臨

en: Acts is the second book Luke wrote to Theophilus; the first is the Gospel of Luke (Luke 1:1-4).
A Sabbath day's walk, the distance from the Mount of Olives to the city, was about 2,000 cubits, roughly 1 km.
The Chapel of the Ascension on the Mount of Olives marks the traditional place; a church stood there by the late 4th century.
zh: 使徒行傳是路加寫給提阿非羅的第二本書；第一本是路加福音（路加福音1章1至4節）。
「安息日可以走的路程」約二千肘，大約1公里，就是橄欖山到城裏的距離。
橄欖山上的升天堂是傳統的升天地點；第四世紀末那裏已建有教堂。

en: On the day of Pentecost a sound like a violent wind fills the house where the believers are together.
Tongues like fire rest on each of them; they are filled with the Holy Spirit and speak in other languages.
Jews from every nation hear them speak about God's mighty works in their own languages.
Peter says this is what the prophet Joel foretold: God pours out his Spirit on all people.
He proclaims that God raised the crucified Jesus and made him Lord and Messiah.
Peter tells them to repent and be baptized; about three thousand are added that day.
The believers devote themselves to teaching, fellowship, breaking bread and prayer, and share their goods.
zh: 五旬節那天，有響聲像一陣狂風，充滿了信徒聚集的屋子。
有舌頭如火焰落在他們各人頭上；他們都被聖靈充滿，說起別國的話來。
從各國來的猶太人，各自聽見他們用自己的鄉談講說神的大作為。
彼得說這正是先知約珥所說的：神要把他的靈澆灌凡有血氣的。
他宣講神已經使被釘十字架的耶穌復活，立他為主，為基督。
彼得叫他們悔改受洗；那一天約有三千人加入。
信徒都恆心遵守使徒的教導，彼此交接，擘餅，禱告，凡物公用。

about.en: I will pour out my Spirit on all people
about.zh: 我要將我的靈澆灌凡有血氣的

about.en: The Festival of Weeks, fifty days after the sheaf offering
about.zh: 初熟禾捆之後五十天的七七節

about.en: The languages are confused at Babel
about.zh: 在巴別變亂人的語言

about.en: Jesus' promise of baptism with the Holy Spirit
about.zh: 耶穌應許要用聖靈施洗

en: Pentecost, Greek for fiftieth, is the Jewish Festival of Weeks (Shavuot), fifty days after Passover, at the wheat harvest.
It was a pilgrim festival, so Jews from across the Roman and Parthian lands came to Jerusalem.
Peter speaks at nine in the morning, the third hour of the day by Jewish reckoning.
zh: 「五旬節」希臘文意思是「第五十」，就是猶太人的七七節，在逾越節後五十天，正值收割小麥的時候。
這是朝聖的節期，所以羅馬和帕提亞各地的猶太人都上耶路撒冷來。
彼得講道的時候是早上九時，按猶太人的算法是白天的第三個時辰。

en: Seven men full of the Spirit are chosen to oversee the daily food for widows; Stephen is one of them.
Stephen does great wonders and signs, and his opponents cannot stand against his wisdom.
False witnesses accuse him before the council of speaking against the temple and the Law.
Stephen retells Israel's history from Abraham to Solomon's temple and says they resist the Holy Spirit.
He sees the heavens opened and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.
They stone him; the witnesses lay their coats at the feet of a young man named Saul.
Stephen prays, Lord, do not hold this sin against them; persecution scatters the church.
zh: 教會選出七個被聖靈充滿的人，管理每天分給寡婦的食物；司提反是其中之一。
司提反行了大奇事和神蹟，反對他的人敵不住他的智慧。
假見證人在議會前控告他說話攻擊聖殿和律法。
司提反從亞伯拉罕講到所羅門建殿的歷史，指責他們常常抗拒聖靈。
他看見天開了，耶穌站在神的右邊。
他們用石頭打他；作證的人把衣服放在一個名叫掃羅的青年腳前。
司提反禱告說：「主啊，不要把這罪歸到他們身上！」教會因受逼迫就分散了。

about.en: Jesus prays, Father, forgive them
about.zh: 耶穌禱告：父啊，赦免他們

about.en: Into your hands I commit my spirit
about.zh: 我將我的靈魂交在你手裏

about.en: Heaven is my throne, the earth my footstool
about.zh: 天是我的座位，地是我的腳凳

about.en: Paul remembers guarding the coats at Stephen's death
about.zh: 保羅回想司提反殉道時他看守衣服

en: The Greek-speaking disciples were Jews who had grown up outside the land; many had come back to live in Jerusalem.
A Greek inscription found in Jerusalem in 1913 records a synagogue built by a priest named Theodotus for visitors from abroad.
The Law prescribed stoning for blasphemy, with the witnesses casting the first stones (Leviticus 24:16; Deuteronomy 17:7).
Stephen is traditionally called the first Christian martyr.
zh: 說希臘話的門徒是在以色列以外長大的猶太人，其中許多人回到耶路撒冷居住。
1913年在耶路撒冷發現一塊希臘文碑文，記載一個名叫提奧多都的祭司為外地來客建造的會堂。
律法規定褻瀆神的要用石頭打死，由證人先動手（利未記24章16節；申命記17章7節）。
傳統上稱司提反為第一位基督徒殉道者。

title.en: Saul meets Jesus on the road

en: Saul gets letters from the high priest to arrest followers of the Way in Damascus.
Near Damascus a light from heaven flashes around him, and he falls to the ground.
A voice says, Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me? I am Jesus.
Saul is blind for three days and neither eats nor drinks.
The Lord sends Ananias, who lays hands on him; something like scales falls from his eyes and he is baptized.
Saul proclaims in the synagogues that Jesus is the Son of God and escapes a plot in a basket.
In Jerusalem Barnabas brings him to the apostles, and the church has peace and grows.
zh: 掃羅向大祭司要了公文，要到大馬色捉拿信奉這道的人。
快到大馬色的時候，忽然有光從天上照着他，他就仆倒在地。
有聲音說：「掃羅，掃羅，你為甚麼迫害我？我就是耶穌。」
掃羅三天看不見，不吃也不喝。
主差遣亞拿尼亞去按手在他身上；有鱗片一樣的東西從他眼中掉下來，他就受了洗。
掃羅在會堂裏宣講耶穌是神的兒子，後來有人用筐子把他從城牆縋下，逃過了謀殺。
在耶路撒冷，巴拿巴帶他去見使徒；教會得平安，人數增多。

about.en: Paul tells of his conversion in Jerusalem
about.zh: 保羅在耶路撒冷述說他的歸主

about.en: Paul tells it again before King Agrippa
about.zh: 保羅在亞基帕王面前再述說

about.en: Paul writes of how God called him
about.zh: 保羅寫到神怎樣呼召他

about.en: Last of all he appeared to me also
about.zh: 末了也顯給我看

en: Damascus, capital of Syria today, is one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world.
The street called Straight was the Roman main street running east to west across Damascus; its line is still a street in the old city.
Saul came from Tarsus in Cilicia, in south-east Turkey today. His conversion is usually dated about AD 33 to 36.
zh: 大馬色就是今天敘利亞的首都大馬士革，是世界上有人居住最久的城市之一。
「直街」是羅馬時代橫貫大馬色東西的大街；舊城裏至今仍有一條街沿着這條路線。
掃羅是基利家的大數人，大數在今天土耳其的東南部。他歸主的時間一般定在主後33年至36年左右。

title.en: Peter's vision: the sheet of animals
title.zh: 彼得的異象：大布裏的動物

en: An angel tells Cornelius, a God-fearing centurion at Caesarea, to send for Peter in Joppa.
Praying on a roof at noon, Peter sees a sheet let down from heaven full of animals.
A voice says, Kill and eat; Peter says he has never eaten anything unclean.
The voice says, What God has made clean, you must not call common. This happens three times.
Cornelius's men arrive, and the Spirit tells Peter to go with them.
At Cornelius's house Peter says God shows no partiality and preaches Jesus.
The Holy Spirit falls on the Gentiles who hear, and Peter has them baptized.
zh: 一位天使吩咐該撒利亞一個敬畏神的百夫長哥尼流，派人到約帕去請彼得。
彼得中午在房頂上禱告，看見天上降下一塊大布，裏面有各樣的動物。
有聲音說：「宰了吃！」彼得說他從來沒有吃過不潔淨的東西。
那聲音說：「神所潔淨的，你不可當作俗物。」這樣一連三次。
哥尼流派來的人到了，聖靈吩咐彼得跟他們去。
彼得在哥尼流家裏說神不偏待人，並傳講耶穌。
聖靈降在聽道的外邦人身上，彼得就吩咐他們受洗。

about.en: Clean and unclean animals in the Law
about.zh: 律法中潔淨和不潔淨的動物

about.en: Peter explains his vision to the church in Jerusalem
about.zh: 彼得向耶路撒冷的教會解釋異象

about.en: Jesus declares all foods clean
about.zh: 耶穌說各樣的食物都是潔淨的

about.en: Paul's vision of the man of Macedonia
about.zh: 保羅看見馬其頓人的異象

en: Joppa is Jaffa, now part of Tel Aviv-Yafo; Caesarea lay about 50 km north along the coast.
Herod the Great built Caesarea with a large harbor about 22 to 10 BC; it became the seat of the Roman governors of Judea.
A centurion commanded about eighty to a hundred soldiers. Houses had flat roofs, used for work, rest and prayer.
zh: 約帕就是雅法，今天屬於特拉維夫－雅法市；該撒利亞在沿海往北約50公里。
大希律約在主前22年至10年建造該撒利亞和它的大港口；後來成了羅馬猶太總督的駐地。
百夫長統領約八十到一百名士兵。當時的房屋是平頂，人可以在上面工作、休息和禱告。

en: The Holy Spirit tells the church at Antioch to set apart Barnabas and Saul, and they are sent off.
They preach in Cyprus and in the synagogue at Antioch in Pisidia; many Gentiles believe.
At Lystra Paul heals a man lame from birth, and the crowd calls them Zeus and Hermes.
Paul is stoned and left for dead, but he gets up and goes on to Derbe.
They appoint elders in each church and report to Antioch how God opened a door of faith to the Gentiles.
On a later journey Paul sees in a vision a man of Macedonia calling, Come and help us!
At Philippi Lydia believes; Paul and Silas are jailed, an earthquake opens the doors, and the jailer believes.
zh: 聖靈吩咐安提阿的教會把巴拿巴和掃羅分別出來，教會就差他們出去。
他們在居比路和彼西底的安提阿的會堂傳道；許多外邦人信了。
在路司得，保羅治好一個生來瘸腿的人，眾人稱他們為丟斯和希耳米。
保羅被石頭打，人以為他死了；他卻起來，往特庇去了。
他們在各教會選立長老，回到安提阿報告神怎樣為外邦人開了信道的門。
後來的旅程中，保羅在異象中看見一個馬其頓人求他說：「請過來幫助我們！」
在腓立比，呂底亞信了主；保羅和西拉被下在監裏，地震使監門大開，獄卒也信了。

about.en: A light for the nations, to the end of the earth
about.zh: 作外邦人的光，直到地極

about.en: Disciples are first called Christians at Antioch
about.zh: 門徒在安提阿首先被稱為基督徒

about.en: The Jerusalem council on the Gentiles
about.zh: 耶路撒冷會議討論外邦信徒的事

about.en: Paul thanks God for the church at Philippi
about.zh: 保羅為腓立比教會感謝神

en: Antioch in Syria, the third city of the Roman Empire, is Antakya in southern Turkey today.
The first journey is usually dated about AD 46 to 48. Cyprus was Barnabas's home (Acts 4:36).
Philippi, in northern Greece, became a Roman colony after the battle fought there in 42 BC; its ruins are a World Heritage Site.
zh: 敘利亞的安提阿是羅馬帝國第三大城，就是今天土耳其南部的安塔基亞。
第一次旅程一般定在主後46年至48年左右。居比路是巴拿巴的家鄉（使徒行傳4章36節）。
腓立比在希臘北部，主前42年那裏的戰役之後成為羅馬殖民城；遺址已列為世界遺產。

en: Paul says, Live by the Spirit, and you will not carry out the desire of the flesh.
The flesh and the Spirit are opposed to each other.
He lists the works of the flesh, such as idolatry, hostility, jealousy, rage and drunkenness.
Those who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.
The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control.
Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh; they are to keep in step with the Spirit.
zh: 保羅說：要順着聖靈而行，就不會去滿足肉體的私慾。
肉體和聖靈彼此相爭。
他列出肉體的作為，例如拜偶像、仇恨、嫉妒、怒氣和醉酒。
做這些事的人必不能承受神的國。
聖靈所結的果子就是仁愛、喜樂、平安、忍耐、恩慈、良善、信實、溫柔、節制。
屬基督的人已經把肉體釘在十字架上了，就要靠聖靈行事。

about.en: The whole Law is fulfilled in loving your neighbor
about.zh: 全律法都包在愛人如己這一句話之內

about.en: The mind set on the flesh and on the Spirit
about.zh: 體貼肉體和體貼聖靈

about.en: I am the vine; you are the branches
about.zh: 我是葡萄樹，你們是枝子

about.en: Like a tree planted by streams of water
about.zh: 像一棵樹栽在溪水旁

en: Galatia was a Roman province in central Anatolia, around Ankara in Turkey today.
Galatians is one of Paul's earliest letters; scholars date it between about AD 48 and 55.
Paul wrote it about whether Gentile believers had to be circumcised and keep the Law of Moses.
zh: 加拉太是羅馬的一個行省，在小亞細亞中部，就是今天土耳其的安卡拉一帶。
加拉太書是保羅最早的書信之一；學者把它定在約主後48年至55年之間。
保羅寫這封信，是討論外邦信徒是否必須受割禮、遵守摩西的律法。

en: Paul says, Be strong in the Lord and put on the full armor of God.
The struggle is not against flesh and blood but against spiritual forces of evil.
Truth is the belt, and righteousness the breastplate.
The readiness of the good news of peace is like shoes on the feet.
Faith is the shield that puts out the flaming arrows of the evil one.
Salvation is the helmet, and the word of God the sword of the Spirit.
Paul asks them to pray at all times, also for him, an ambassador in chains.
zh: 保羅說：要靠着主剛強，穿上神所賜的全副軍裝。
我們不是與血肉之軀搏鬥，而是與邪惡的靈界勢力搏鬥。
用真理作帶子束腰，用義作鎧甲。
把傳平安福音的準備當作鞋子穿在腳上。
拿起信心作盾牌，撲滅那惡者一切燒着的箭。
戴上救恩作頭盔，拿起聖靈的寶劍，就是神的話。
保羅請他們隨時禱告，也為他這戴着鎖鏈的使者禱告。

about.en: God puts on righteousness as a breastplate
about.zh: 神以公義為鎧甲

about.en: Righteousness the belt around his waist
about.zh: 公義必當作他腰間的帶子

about.en: The breastplate of faith and love, the helmet of hope
about.zh: 以信和愛當作護心鏡，以得救的盼望當作頭盔

about.en: Put on the armor of light
about.zh: 穿上光明的兵器

en: A Roman legionary wore a belt, a metal breastplate, hobnailed sandals and a helmet, and carried a short sword.
The large Roman shield, the scutum, was made of wood covered with leather, which could be soaked to stop burning arrows.
Paul wrote as a prisoner (Ephesians 6:20), traditionally in Rome about AD 60 to 62. Ephesus lies near Selçuk in Turkey.
zh: 羅馬軍團的士兵束腰帶，穿金屬胸甲和釘鞋，戴頭盔，佩帶短劍。
羅馬人的大盾牌是木製的，外面包着皮革；皮革浸濕以後可以擋住火箭。
保羅寫這封信時是囚犯（以弗所書6章20節），傳統認為是約主後60年至62年在羅馬。以弗所在今天土耳其的塞爾丘克附近。

en: Hebrews says a great cloud of witnesses surrounds us, the people of faith of chapter 11.
Lay aside every weight and sin, and run with endurance the race set before us.
Fix your eyes on Jesus, who endured the cross and sat down at the right hand of God's throne.
Paul says all runners run, but only one receives the prize; run so as to win.
Athletes train with self-control for a wreath that withers; we for one that does not.
Paul does not run aimlessly or box the air, so that he will not be disqualified.
zh: 希伯來書說，我們有許多見證人如同雲彩圍繞着，就是第11章所講那些有信心的人。
要放下各樣的重擔和罪，以堅忍的心奔跑擺在前頭的賽程。
要定睛仰望耶穌；他忍受了十字架，現在坐在神寶座的右邊。
保羅說，賽跑的人都在跑，但只有一個人得獎；你們也要這樣跑，好得着獎賞。
運動員凡事節制，是為了會朽壞的冠冕；我們卻是為了不朽壞的冠冕。
保羅跑步不是漫無目標，打拳不是打空氣，免得自己被取消資格。

about.en: Faith, by which the people of old received God's approval
about.zh: 信心，古人因此蒙了神的悅納

about.en: I have finished the race; the crown of righteousness
about.zh: 我已經跑完了賽程；公義的冠冕

about.en: I press on toward the goal for the prize
about.zh: 向着標竿直跑，要得獎賞

about.en: They will run and not grow weary
about.zh: 他們奔跑卻不困倦

en: The Isthmian Games were held near Corinth every two years; winners received a wreath of pine or of wild celery.
Athletes trained for months before the games under strict rules, and competitors swore to keep them.
The author of Hebrews is not named in the letter; it was written in the first century, probably before about AD 95.
zh: 地峽運動會每兩年在哥林多附近舉行一次；優勝者得到松枝或野芹編成的冠冕。
運動員在比賽前要按嚴格的規定接受好幾個月的訓練，參賽者要起誓遵守。
希伯來書的作者沒有在書中署名；這書寫於第一世紀，大概在主後95年以前。

en: James asks what good it is to say one has faith but have no works.
Telling a hungry, poorly clothed brother to keep warm and eat, without giving him anything, does no good.
So faith by itself, without works, is dead.
Even the demons believe that God is one, and they shudder.
Abraham offered Isaac, and his faith was made complete by his works.
Rahab welcomed the messengers and sent them out another way.
As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead.
zh: 雅各問：人若說自己有信心，卻沒有行為，有甚麼益處呢？
對缺衣少食的弟兄說「要穿得暖、吃得飽」，卻不給他所需用的，有甚麼用處呢？
信心若沒有行為，本身就是死的。
連鬼魔也信神只有一位，卻是戰兢。
亞伯拉罕把以撒獻在祭壇上，他的信心因行為才得以完全。
喇合接待了使者，又從另一條路把他們送走。
身體沒有靈魂是死的，信心沒有行為也是死的。

about.en: Abram believed the LORD, and it was credited as righteousness
about.zh: 亞伯蘭信耶和華，耶和華就算他為義

about.en: Abraham offers Isaac
about.zh: 亞伯拉罕獻以撒

about.en: Rahab hides the spies in Jericho
about.zh: 喇合在耶利哥收藏探子

about.en: Saved by grace through faith, created for good works
about.zh: 因信靠恩得救，為要行善

en: James is traditionally the brother of Jesus who led the church in Jerusalem (Acts 15:13; Galatians 1:19).
The Jewish historian Josephus records that this James was stoned in Jerusalem about AD 62.
The letter is addressed to the twelve tribes in the Dispersion, that is, Jewish believers living outside the land.
zh: 傳統認為雅各書的作者是耶穌的弟弟雅各，耶路撒冷教會的領袖（使徒行傳15章13節；加拉太書1章19節）。
猶太歷史學家約瑟夫記載，這位雅各約在主後62年在耶路撒冷被石頭打死。
這封信是寫給「散居各地的十二個支派」，就是住在以色列以外的猶太信徒。

title.en: Revelation: the throne and the Lamb

en: John sees a door open in heaven and a throne with someone seated on it.
Around the throne are twenty-four elders and four living creatures who never stop saying, Holy, holy, holy.
The elders lay their crowns before the throne and praise God as creator of all things.
The One on the throne holds a scroll sealed with seven seals, and no one is worthy to open it.
The Lion of the tribe of Judah has conquered; John sees a Lamb standing, as though slaughtered.
The Lamb takes the scroll, and they sing a new song: by his blood he bought people from every nation.
Countless angels and every creature praise the One on the throne and the Lamb.
zh: 約翰看見天上有門開了，有一個寶座，有一位坐在上面。
寶座周圍有二十四位長老和四個活物；活物晝夜不停地說：「聖哉！聖哉！聖哉！」
長老們把冠冕放在寶座前，讚美神創造了萬物。
坐寶座的那一位手中有一卷用七個印封着的書卷，沒有一個配展開它。
猶大支派中的獅子已經得勝了；約翰看見有羔羊站着，像是被宰殺過的。
羔羊拿了書卷，他們唱新歌說：他用自己的血從各邦國中買了人來歸神。
千萬的天使和一切被造之物都讚美坐寶座的和羔羊。

about.en: Isaiah sees the Lord on a throne: Holy, holy, holy
about.zh: 以賽亞看見主坐在寶座上：聖哉！聖哉！聖哉！

about.en: Ezekiel sees four living creatures
about.zh: 以西結看見四個活物

about.en: Look, the Lamb of God
about.zh: 看哪，神的羔羊

about.en: Like a lamb led to the slaughter
about.zh: 像羊羔被牽去宰殺

en: John received the Revelation on Patmos (1:9), a small Greek island in the Aegean Sea off the west coast of Turkey.
Most date the book to about AD 95, under the emperor Domitian; some date it to the late 60s.
A scroll could be sealed with lumps of clay or wax pressed with a seal; it could not be read until the seals were broken.
zh: 約翰在拔摩海島領受啟示（1章9節）；拔摩是愛琴海上的一個希臘小島，在土耳其西岸外。
多數學者把這書定在約主後95年，羅馬皇帝多米田在位的時候；也有人定在60年代後期。
書卷可以用泥或蠟封住，再蓋上印章；印不揭開，就不能讀。

title.en: God unifies all things in Christ: a new heaven and a new earth
title.zh: 神使萬有在基督裏同歸於一：新天新地

en: Paul writes that God's plan is to bring all things in heaven and on earth together under Christ.
John sees a new heaven and a new earth, and the new Jerusalem coming down from God.
A voice says God will dwell with his people and wipe away every tear; death will be no more.
The One on the throne says, Look, I am making all things new.
The city has no temple, for its temple is the Lord God and the Lamb, and the Lamb is its lamp.
The river of the water of life flows from the throne, with the tree of life on either side.
Jesus says, I am coming soon; John answers, Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!
zh: 保羅寫道，神的計劃是使天上和地上的萬有，都在基督裏同歸於一。
約翰看見一個新天新地，又看見新耶路撒冷從神那裏降下來。
有聲音說神要與人同住，擦去他們一切的眼淚；不再有死亡。
坐寶座的說：「看哪，我把一切都更新了！」
城裏沒有聖殿，因為主神和羔羊就是城的聖殿；羔羊就是城的燈。
生命水的河從寶座流出來，河的兩岸有生命樹。
耶穌說：「我快要來了！」約翰回應：「阿們！主耶穌啊，願你來！」

about.en: The garden of Eden, the tree of life and a river
about.zh: 伊甸園、生命樹和河

about.en: I am creating new heavens and a new earth
about.zh: 我要創造新天新地

about.en: A river flows from the temple, with trees for healing
about.zh: 河從聖殿流出，兩岸的樹可以醫病

about.en: God reconciles all things to himself through Christ
about.zh: 神藉着基督使萬有與自己和好

en: The Bible begins in a garden with the tree of life (Genesis 2) and ends in a city with the tree of life (Revelation 22).
The city measures 12,000 stadia on each side (21:16), about 2,200 km.
The jewels of the foundations (21:19-20) recall the twelve stones on the high priest's breastpiece (Exodus 28:17-21).
zh: 聖經以有生命樹的園子開始（創世記2章），以有生命樹的城結束（啟示錄22章）。
這城每邊長一萬二千斯塔迪（21章16節），約2200公里。
城牆根基的寶石（21章19至20節）令人想起大祭司胸牌上的十二顆寶石（出埃及記28章17至21節）。
